data.long_meaning: Rhana is an Arabic name that means 'look' or 'gaze'. It symbolizes a person with a strong sense of observation and insight. The name Rhana carries the meaning “Look, gaze, or vision” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rhana usually hope their child will grow to embody look, gaze, or vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
